expected: ensure_read_only raises UnsafeSQLError for INCR/DECR calls and serial advances in any case and spacing, and allows serial reads, columns such as incr_count and string literals that mention INCR. The policy invariants still hold. This is offline evidence; whether a SELECT-only user can change data on a server is shown only by the live integration test.
non_goals: no change to write mode, the whitelist off path or any other read-only rule
no claim that a live CUBRID rejected the statements unless a live run is recorded
problem: ensure_read_only scans only sqlparse Keyword tokens, so a SELECT that calls INCR(col) or DECR(col), advances a serial (serial.NEXT_VALUE, serial.NEXTVAL, SERIAL_NEXT_VALUE(serial, n)) or uses SELECT ... WITH INCREMENT/DECREMENT FOR col passes execute_query and explain_query and changes data that the rollback after the read does not undo, even for a user granted only SELECT. Make read-only mode reject these in any case, bare or quoted, with comments or whitespace between tokens, while serial reads (CURRENT_VALUE, CURRVAL, SERIAL_CURRENT_VALUE) and columns whose names merely contain the words stay allowed. Do not loosen any other check and do not change write mode.
title: Reject read-only queries that change data through INCR, DECR or serial advances
